push.title: W 4-0 vs unbeatables FC | You: 10.0 (top 10% FOR)
push.body:
Well, butter my biscuit, PhogsToffees. A 10.0. Folks in the top 10% of forwards don't play much better than that.

DID WELL
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 1). That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ A goal against unbeatables FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. Never gets old, and I hope it never does.
+ Man of the Match, your 4th for us. The game noticed, and so did I.
+ You and tuxedo_slide were on the same wavelength, like two radios tuned to the good station.
+ 2.3 above your usual. Somebody's been eating their Wheaties.

WORK ON
- Pass accuracy: 80%. Decent, but top-quarter forwards get to 88%+. That's the next rung.
- Shots: 1. You're in the neighborhood. The fancy houses start at 3+.

That's the kind of night that makes me glad I took this job. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-0 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.6 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, I've seen sunsets in Kansas less beautiful than that 8.6. Top 10% for a midfielder.

DID WELL
+ A goal against unbeatables FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's the stuff they write songs about. Bad songs, but songs.
+ 1 assist. A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few.
+ You & tuxedo_slide clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ 0.7 better than usual. That's a staircase, and you're climbing it.
+ 6 completed passes was worth +0.1 on its own. That's the quiet stuff that wins.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted. Little homework: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
- You and tuxedo_slide share this one: defensive work rate. Tandem fix: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 2 misplaced passes: -0.1. Like leaving the porch light on all day. Small, but it adds up.

Coach's drill: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

Believe. And maybe stretch. - Coach Lasso

tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.

weaknesses.title: Playing forward
tips: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
weaknesses.coach: Plenty of the ball, but not much going forward. Let's hurt 'em with it.

push.title: W 4-0 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.5 (top 25% MID)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.5 against unbeatables FC. That's top-25% midfielder work, and it didn't happen by accident.

DID WELL
+ 14 passes (down from your usual 16). Everybody wanted the ball at your feet, and for good reason.
+ A brace against unbeatables FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. You put it where the keeper ain't. That's the whole trick.
+ 1.0 above your average. Somebody's been doing their homework.
+ 2 shots on target bought you +0.1. Sprinkles on the sundae.
+ League-wide, an 8.5 is top 25% territory for a midfielder.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
- 57% passing (8 of 14). Coach's secret: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
- No key passes from 14 passes. Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.
- You and BellyTb1, same defensive work rate homework. Partners: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 3 shots off target cost 0.1. Squeaky wheel; let's oil it.

Before next match: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

If I had a gold star sticker, you'd get the whole sheet. - Coach Lasso
